title: Incorta Intelligence
markdown:
THE PROBLEM

‍

## Without context, AI guesses

Most enterprise AI is running blind. Pulling from stale exports, siloed systems, and incomplete data, it fills in the gaps when the foundation breaks down - giving you hallucinated answers, broken workflows, and outputs no one trusts enough to act on. Without accurate, live context, AI can only guess.

## Give your AI the   data foundation it deserves

![Blue cylindrical database icon with two horizontal white sections.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67b7abfbb037e687d0a415ec/67e9752be7cebcc5e1a3f182_Incorta-Manufacturing-Icon-01.svg)

##### **All your data, from any source, in one place**

Incorta Intelligence brings together your structured and unstructured data so your AI always has the full picture.

![Blue speedometer or gauge icon with five circular markers on the right side.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67b7abfbb037e687d0a415ec/67e9758ea8ca6190913bd368_Incorta-Manufactung-Icon.svg)

##### **From insight to action, automatically**

Build and deploy specialized agents faster than ever - each running on live operational data, with built-in workflows that hold invoices, release payments, update records, and escalate to humans when needed.

![Icon of a rounded square containing four vertical bars of varying heights representing a bar chart.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67b7abfbb037e687d0a415ec/67e975397e00d84a7365d19e_Incorta-Manufacturing-Icon-03.svg)

##### **Trust every answer**

Every response is grounded in your real data and scored for accuracy. Built-in hallucination mitigation, role-based access, full audit trails, and SOC 2 Type II certification mean your security rules carry over automatically.

ANALYST STUDIO

## Trusted AI starts with trusted data

Before Incorta Intelligence can reason over your data, your data has to be ready — cleaned, joined, and reshaped into something dependable. Analyst Studio puts that work in the hands of the business teams who know the data best, not just the IT teams waiting in a ticket queue.

An AI Workflow Assistant turns a plain-language request into a governed pipeline, so the data feeding every layer below is data your teams actually trust.

[Explore Analyst Studio](https://www.incorta.com/demo)

### No-code, AI-assisted

Clean, join, and reshape data without SQL or a separate tool

### Built for business users

Finance, marketing, and ops teams self-serve their own transformations

### Governed from the start

Every pipeline inherits Incorta's lineage, access, and audit controls

HOW IT WORKS

## Four layers. One platform.

Incorta Intelligence sits directly on top of your existing enterprise systems as an operational AI layer:

ready to connect, reason, and **act without complex data engineering or infrastructure overhaul**.

CASE STUDY

## AI-powered legal intelligence,   at scale

A government judiciary body needed a faster way to surface insights from tens of thousands of legal records. **‍** They chose Incorta to build a custom AI agent on top of 70,000+ sale and rental dispute cases - giving legal and policy analysts a way to ask questions in plain language and get instant, accurate answers.

- Explore case outcomes and spot rulings trends conversationally

- Get instant answers to policy and compliance questions

- Access deep insights without SQL or a dashboard
